judged_text: External feed content is stored and served as unsanitized raw HTML: the RSS path has no sanitization at all before content becomes `cooked`, the readability path whitelists tags but permits `javascript:` URLs in href/src attributes, and the feed-supplied URL is interpolated unescaped into HTML — a malicious or hijacked feed yields stored script running on the Discourse origin.

adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly introduces a "raw_html" cook path that bypasses the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline: `Post#cook` returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), and TopicEmbed imports create posts with `cook_method: ...[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). The RSS poller feeds `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` directly into `TopicEmbed.import` with no sanitization (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), and the embed view renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), yielding stored HTML/JS execution on the Discourse origin. Additionally, `imported_from` appends an `#{url}` string built via interpolation into the HTML (topic_embed.rb) and the only URL check is `/^https?\:\/\//`, which does not prevent quote-breaking/injection characters in the URL. The readability path’s protocol handling (e.g., `javascript:`) cannot be verified from this diff, but the unsanitized raw HTML storage/rendering issue is directly evidenced.
